stories.title: Trump cancels Defense Secretary Hegseth's plan to livestream Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan's execution
stories.reason: Trump said the December 3 firing-squad execution will proceed but will not be broadcast, reversing Hegseth's announcement after bipartisan criticism, with a White House official saying Trump had not realized Hasan was paralyzed when he first considered the idea.

stories.title: Israeli settlers burn olive trees and injure a Washington Post photojournalist in a West Bank attack
stories.reason: Roughly 80 settlers attacked olive pickers near Ramallah, with monitoring group Yesh Din recording at least 170 such attacks since late September, the start of this year's harvest season, as witnesses say an armed settler fired a gun during the assault.

stories.title: Trump's approval rating falls to a record-low 36% in a new Fox News poll
stories.reason: The survey found inflation is his weakest issue at just 22% approval, Republican approval of him hit a record low of 76%, and Democrats now lead Republicans by nine points on the generic midterm ballot.

stories.title: A 19-year-old is charged with plotting a mass shooting at a Hindu temple in suburban Chicago
stories.reason: Prosecutors say Alexandros Paporakis drove to the Aurora temple with a rifle that malfunctioned, and that a manifesto recovered by police referenced violence against Indian, Jewish, Black and other 'non-white' people, after a coworker alerted authorities to his messages.

stories.title: Gartner warns over $3.5 trillion in AI infrastructure spending could face impairment by 2030
stories.reason: The firm says AI providers need about $8.5 trillion in revenue through 2030 to cover planned capital spending and financing costs, against a forecast ceiling of just $3.6 trillion in AI-attributable revenue, and expects more than 80% of smaller 'neocloud' GPU providers to fold by then.

stories.title: The Justice Department sues California, seeking to block mail ballots from 20,000 alleged noncitizen voters
stories.reason: The suit, filed weeks before the midterms, asks a federal judge to compel the state to set aside the ballots pending citizenship verification after California didn't act on a 48-hour DOJ deadline, while Governor Newsom calls it a 'desperate attempt' at voter suppression.

stories.title: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh gives no rate signal at the IMF meetings, and October hike odds collapse
stories.reason: Warsh's refusal to telegraph the Fed's next move in Bangkok sent October rate-hike odds tumbling to about 15% from nearly 28%, even as he called AI the biggest economic shift he has witnessed and warned its transition will be 'very bumpy.'

stories.title: The White House's Super Intelligence task force adopts its charter to assess AI risks within 120 days
stories.reason: The charter directs a presidential science advisory council to assess cybersecurity, biosecurity and model-control risks while a Pentagon undersecretary drafts breach-reporting rules for AI labs, building on a voluntary industry accord that critics say favors self-policing over new regulation.
